messages:
maria: Heads up folks 11:01 deploy made Metric Explorer small-multiples stutter when panning + hover tooltips. UI main thread blocks ~3-5s.

dustin: I can repro on canary. Devtools shows big JSON.parse spikes during hover (~1s).

raj: what landed in the deploy? routing policy change or telemetry?

maria: not routing. Telemetry sampling/schema change went out in same deploy. Payload sizes jumped.

telemetry-bot: NOTICE: sample_rate increased 1%->5% at 11:02. New envelope may include optional raw_span field; some traces now ~700-900KB.

elaine: that explains main-thread parse work. Are we still parsing on the main thread anywhere?

sam: we used to parse in a worker but a previous rollback due to service-worker scope issues moved parsing back to main thread on stable. Canary should have the worker path but looks like large envelopes break the flow.

dustin: quick repro command (sanitized):

curl -X POST https://console.canary/api/telemetry -d '{"sample_rate":0.05,"trace":"<big_raw_span>..."}'
# then open Metric Explorer and hover a point

raj: timeline matches: deploy 11:01, telemetry change 11:02, hover latency spike immediately after.

maria: options: rollback raw_span for frontend consumers (fast), or re-enable worker parsing with size guard (safer long-term).

dustin: I prepared a small client guard: if (payload.size > 100*1024) offloadToWorker(payload) else JSON.parse(payload). Will open PR.

sam: if we offload/skip heavy traces we should show a tooltip note like "trace omitted (size) - view full trace asynchronously" so users know why tooltip lacks a trace.

elaine: also audit routing paths 1roxying via eu-proxy could add ingestion latency but UX here points to CPU parse.

raj: immediate plan: 1) rollback raw_span injection on canary now, 2) land client hotfix with worker parse + 100KB threshold, 3) add 95th-percentile payload-size alert and dashboard, 4) add an e2e perf test for Metric Explorer with large traces.

maria: rolling back canary now. @dustin open the hotfix PR and tag @sam for tooltip copy.

dustin: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/pulls/987 (adds worker parse, 100KB guard, tests).

sam: will draft UX copy and add a small acceptance test.

telemetry-bot: rollback complete for canary at 11:25 UTC. raw_span dropped by default for frontend envelopes.

maria: verified 11:281.js latency back to baseline, hover snappy again. Thanks team :tada: 

raj: follow-ups: unit test for worker fallback, e2e perf scenario with synthetic large traces, routing-policy audit for telemetry endpoints, and update rollout playbook so telemetry schema changes require canary opt-in + perf smoke.

dustin: filing follow-up tickets and will include tests in the hotfix branch.

maria: closing loop 1 will update playbook and note the policy.

sam: great catch everyone.
